segments.text: A school notice changes Nora's day. Early dismissal comes before her recorded pickup.

segments.speaker: rosina
segments.text: I check Nora's schedule and who can help, then draft a new pickup plan for Kendra to approve.

segments.speaker: rosina
segments.text: With Kendra's approval, the request goes to Loretta, a test caregiver.

segments.speaker: loretta
segments.text: Yes, I can be there at 1:20. I'll head out now so I'm not rushing.

segments.speaker: rosina
